title: Height limitations.
officialText:
Vertical sections of exterior leaders made from galvanized steel, galvanized wrought iron,
cast iron, brass, or similar heavy material shall be permitted only for the first 15 feet (4572 mm) of leader extending up from
grade, provided that the leader is securely anchored with offset clamps to the face of the building at no fewer than two points
along the vertical section of the leader. Horizontal sections of exterior gutter made from such heavy materials shall not be
permitted higher than 15 feet (4572 mm) above grade.
